Fixtures of public/science/imaging/display (ADR-0401 §SD7, verification
plan). Everything here is synthetic: written on 2026-11-21 by
gen_zscale_oracle.py.txt with astropy 8.0.3 and numpy 2.5.5 as the
reference implementation (astropy.visualization.ZScaleInterval). It carries
no third-party data and no licence beyond this repository's.

zscale_oracle.tsv   astropy's zscale limits for fifteen fields the script
                    computes and zscale_test.go recomputes from the same
                    formulas: flat noise (also under contrast 1, which puts
                    both ends inside the sample), noise with bright blobs
                    (also under another contrast and sample count, and as
                    unsigned 16-bit under a negative value transform), a
                    gradient, NaNs (also under contrast 1), a declared
                    invalid value, a heavy tail (also with five times the
                    samples), images smaller than the sample, one of four
                    pixels, and a one-pixel-wide strip. astropy is given
                    the package's own sample of each field whole, so what
                    is compared is the fit, not the sampling rule.
